manifest.path_note: relative to a local directory holding bytes whose SHA256 equals resource_sha256; the profiler refuses any other bytes
manifest.split_rule: Time-Series-Library Dataset_Custom: num_train=int(N*0.7), num_test=int(N*0.2), vali=rest; TRAIN rows [0,num_train). Source: data_provider/data_loader.py (Dataset_Custom). Confirmed by existing CHARACTERIZATION sets where present
manifest.target_note: multivariate (M) protocol: every channel is both an input and a forecast target; OT is the S/MS target. Admissible as a lagged input only
manifest.availability: retrospective public benchmark; availability UNDECLARED/UNKNOWN; not point-in-time financial data

resource_identity.note: every byte hashed for identity; no value past the TRAIN boundary parsed

train_prefix.split_rule: Time-Series-Library Dataset_Custom: num_train=int(N*0.7), num_test=int(N*0.2), vali=rest; TRAIN rows [0,num_train). Source: data_provider/data_loader.py (Dataset_Custom). Confirmed by existing CHARACTERIZATION sets where present

columns.declared_reason: time index; never a branch input
columns.exclusion_reason: time index; never a branch input

grouping: one admissible feature per branch; metrics propose, inner validation decides

redundancy.rule: Pearson on TRAIN rows with every selected column finite; descriptive, never merges

lagged.consequence: lag-informed grouping must be fitted inside inner folds (protocol step G3)

assumptions: No imputation; temporal metrics use the longest contiguous finite run
Values are profiled as stored (no scaler); TSL loaders standardize with a TRAIN-fitted scaler later
ADF/KPSS p-values are descriptive and unadjusted for multiple testing
Point-in-time availability is not certified by this profile
No target, no model and no holdout value enters any statistic
